synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: The St Kilda signals point to multi-unit rather than single-dwelling work: aussielocksmith.com.au's St Kilda FAQ is specifically "Are your locksmiths familiar with apartment complexes in St Kilda?" and answers with smart locks plus master key systems for apartments and holiday rentals, while the Airtasker St Kilda VIC lock-installation listings show smart lock requests sitting alongside diamond-grille security screen doors with one-way aluminium mesh, deadlocks and door closers — so a St Kilda smart lock job frequently has to integrate with an existing master-keyed common entrance or work behind a security screen door rather than replace a bare timber front door.
synthesis.council_notes: None identified — no returned record references a heritage overlay, council permit or owners-corporation rule. The only adjacent signal is that St Kilda work routinely involves apartment complexes and holiday rentals (aussielocksmith.com.au), so permission for common-property entrances should be verified manually rather than asserted.
synthesis.demographic_skew: 24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au addresses its St Kilda page to "a homeowner, tenant or a landlord" with a "home or investment property" and leads on "Changing the Keys of the existing locks when moving in", and aussielocksmith.com.au adds holiday rentals — so the demand here is tenancy- and short-stay-turnover driven, where the buying trigger is handing over and revoking access repeatedly rather than a one-off owner-occupier upgrade.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted to an apartment complex's entrance and integrated with the existing master key system rather than only the unit door — aussielocksmith.com.au runs this as its explicit St Kilda FAQ, answering with smart locks and master key systems for apartments and holiday rentals.

Losing control of access after a tenant, previous key holder or short-stay guest leaves — nonstoplocksmiths.com.au frames its St Kilda smart lock answer around removing "access from previous key holders", and 24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au leads with changing the keys of existing locks when moving in.

Whether a smart lock will work alongside an existing security screen door and deadlock instead of forcing the whole door set-up to be redone — the Airtasker St Kilda VIC lock-installation listings pair diamond-grille security door, one-way aluminium mesh, deadlock and door closer requests with smart lock requests.

Whether to keep the traditional deadlock or convert the whole lock set to smart — gorillasecurity.com.au offers St Kilda residents the choice to "replace the locks or upgrade the entire network with smart locks", and 24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au lists traditional deadlocks and digital smart locks side by side.
